equal_information.definition: render.equal_information: POINTER vs NAIVE_APPEND over the same chain -- same message count, same concatenated content
equal_information.verdict: Equal information holds WITHIN each arm. It cannot hold ACROSS the arms, and the reason is one-directional: the append form is a strict information superset. All 3 bodies of the in-place arm (the summary + the 2 retained turns) appear in the append prompt, while 16 of the 17 folded turn bodies exist only in the append arm -- those are exactly what SUMMARISE_IN_PLACE rewrites away, and dropping them is the definition of an in-place fold, not a defect. What APPEND_NOTE cannot carry is the other half of compaction: a token reduction. APPEND_NOTE tokens 8343 -> 8574 (+231, +2.8%), so a budget that was exceeded stays exceeded and a fixed-budget runner will re-compact on the next turn; SUMMARISE_IN_PLACE 8343 -> 1028. This is asserted, not smoothed over (tests/test_context_append_note.py::test_append_and_summarise_are_not_equal_information_across_arms).
